容器健康检查端点，返回 200 和 ok，无需鉴权。: Container health endpoint. Returns HTTP 200 and ok without authentication.
免鉴权的 OIDC 连通性诊断：报告 userinfo 端点是否可达与最近错误，: Unauthenticated OIDC connectivity diagnostics: reports userinfo availability and the latest error to troubleshoot HTTP 401 in the management UI.
合并所有健康上游的模型。只返回带来源前缀的模型名，例如 model-hub/xx: Combines models from all healthy upstreams. Only source-qualified names are returned, such as model-hub/xxx, image-studio/xxx, registered/xxx, manual/xxx and com.ictrek.ai/xxx.
OpenAI 兼容。model 必须使用 /v1/models 返回的带来源前缀: OpenAI-compatible. Use a source-qualified model name from /v1/models. Requests are forwarded to the upstream; stream=true forwards tokens as they arrive.
OpenAI 兼容。路由到 embedding 角色的上游（如 Model Hu: OpenAI-compatible. Routes to embedding upstreams, such as Model Hub bge-m3 or discovered ML Server Qwen3/CLIP text embeddings. ML Server does not report tokenizer usage, so usage is omitted without failing the request.
版本、上游健康数、模型数、累计请求、是否启用 API Key。: Version, healthy upstream count, model count, total requests and API key enforcement.
管理视图：每个模型带上游名称、上游类型、是否短名别名等元数据。: Management view: includes upstream name, upstream type and short-name alias metadata for each model.
从 JSONL 历史按模型、上游和用户汇总请求及上游报告的输入/输出 Token: Aggregates requests and upstream-reported input/output tokens from JSONL history by model, upstream and user. period accepts day (default), week, month or all. Requests still complete when the upstream does not report usage.
当前用户可见的全部上游（本地发现 + 云端/手动添加 + 主动注册），密钥不回显: All upstreams visible to the current user: discovered, cloud/manual and registered. Secrets are never returned. status values: healthy; paused (scheduling disabled); lease_expired; circuit_open (consecutive connection failures, failures count and circuit_open_until cooldown; the next request probes recovery after cooldown); auth_failed (model probe returned 401/403, with the original reason in detail); discovery_failed; no_models (reachable but no usable models); full (max_inflight reached). manageable indicates whether the caller may edit, refresh, delete or configure scheduling (owner or administrator). Private upstreams appear only to their owner and administrators.
按当前表单参数探测模型列表；可提交 test_model 做一次轻量联通测试。失: Probes models using the current form parameters. Optional test_model performs a lightweight connectivity test. A failed probe returns diagnostics without saving the upstream.
添加云端或手动上游: Add a cloud or manual upstream
登记上游，kind 支持 manual/cloud，protocol 支持 op: Registers an upstream. kind: manual/cloud. protocol: openai (native), chat_completions (Responses/Messages conversion), anthropic (native), offline_asr (/transcribe adapter), image_studio (image/video adapter), async_task (generic asynchronous image task creation/polling). Cloud model prefixes reverse the domain, e.g. ai.ictrek.com -> com.ictrek.ai. Models are probed before saving; async_task validates the single-model/task configuration without creating a paid task. visibility: public (default, shared with all callers) or private (owner and administrators only). The creator becomes owner; only the owner and administrators may edit, refresh, delete or configure scheduling. Legacy upstreams with an empty owner remain shared and manageable by all signed-in users.
更新云端或手动上游: Update a cloud or manual upstream
修改名称、地址、协议、密钥或可见范围；api_key 留空表示保留原密钥。云端上: Updates name, URL, protocol, key or visibility. An empty api_key retains the existing key. Cloud model prefixes are recalculated from base_url. Owner and administrators only: editing another user's public upstream returns 403; accessing their private upstream returns 404. Ownership cannot be transferred.
重新探测 API 创建的云端/手动上游并刷新其模型列表。仅 owner 和管理员: Probes and refreshes models for API-created cloud/manual upstreams. Owner and administrators only.
删除云端或手动上游: Delete a cloud or manual upstream
删除后其模型立即从 /v1/models 移除，同时清除该上游的资源归属记录；M: Immediately removes its models from /v1/models and clears upstream resource ownership records. Discovered Model Hub and registered upstreams cannot be deleted here. Owner and administrators only.
返回当前版本全部端点的说明与示例；管理界面的“API 文档”页由此实时渲染，永远: Returns descriptions and examples for every endpoint in the running version. The API Documentation tab renders this contract live. Use lang=en for English; the default is Chinese.
调用归集到对应 VOS 用户；管理 API 必须以此登录（或使用网关 Key）。: Calls are attributed to the corresponding VOS user. Management APIs require this identity or a gateway key. Other VOS applications can use their own Fastpath token on the same-origin /api/com.ictrek.v-scheduler/v1/* path; calls are attributed to their current user without registering with V-Router.
以 gateway-admin 身份调用，计入管理员用量: Calls use the gateway-admin identity and count towards administrator usage.
仅关闭 REQUIRE_KEY 时模型推理可匿名使用，归集为 internal；: Anonymous model inference is available only when REQUIRE_KEY is disabled and is attributed to internal. Management and pinned resource APIs reject anonymous callers.
其他 VOS 应用：用 V-Router 模型列表生成下拉框: Other VOS apps: populate model selectors from V-Router
推荐方式是用户先在 V-Router 里配置内置 Ollama、云端 API、上: Configure the built-in Ollama services, cloud APIs, upstream keys, weights and concurrency in V-Router first. Other apps only read models and call the unified /v1/* API. A signed-in VOS account can reuse its Fastpath/OIDC token on the same-origin /api/com.ictrek.v-scheduler path.
其他 VOS 应用：读取带来源元数据的模型列表: Other VOS apps: read model source metadata
普通下拉框用 /v1/models 即可；需要按能力筛选时用 /api/v1/m: Use /v1/models for ordinary selectors; use /api/v1/models for capability filtering. Do not reject models solely because capabilities are unknown; display the specific gateway or upstream error after calling.
指定来源与指定上游: Select a source or pin an upstream
模型名必须带来源前缀，例如 v-scheduler/ollama-qa/、reg: Use source-qualified model names, e.g. v-scheduler/ollama-qa/, registered/ or com.ictrek.ai/. To pin an instance, pass X-VRouter-Upstream:<ID> and use the upstream-native model name.
注册模型 API：public 或 private: Register a model API: public or private
visibility=public 时所有 VOS 用户和匿名内网推理都可在 /: visibility=public makes models visible to all VOS users and anonymous internal inference through /v1/models. visibility=private limits visibility to the registrant's VOS identity and administrators. Use a stable, distinct service_id per instance; register again when models change.
注册单个模型：声明接口和能力: Register one model: declare endpoints and capabilities
单模型注册不会探测 /models，必须提供 model 和 endpoints: Single-model registration does not probe /models; model and endpoints are required. endpoints determines available interfaces; capabilities/model_kind supports older clients and capability fallback. Unsupported interfaces return specific gateway or upstream errors.
offline_asr 将 OpenAI 兼容 /v1/audio/transc: offline_asr converts the multipart file in OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions to raw audio for upstream POST /transcribe?lang=<language>. Suitable for offline ASR services on VOS or the host.
注册租约续期和注销: Renew or remove a registration lease
响应返回 registered-<service_id>，建议每 ttl/3 秒: The response returns registered-<service_id>. Renew every ttl/3 seconds. A heartbeat 404 means the lease expired, the gateway restarted or the caller is not owner/admin; register again.
其他 VOS 应用携带自身 Fastpath token 即可。401 时重新授: Other VOS apps can reuse their Fastpath token. Reauthorize after 401; invalid credentials never fall back to anonymous. Registered services support public/private visibility; private services are visible only to their registrant and administrators.
固定上游访问资源: Access resources on a pinned upstream
从上游页取得 ID，创建、查询和删除保持同一上游；模型字段使用原生名称。经 V-: Get the ID from the upstream page. Keep creation, queries and deletion on the same upstream, using native model names. Resources created through V-Router record their owner; other users get 404 (owner and administrators are exempt). Lists include all resources of the shared upstream account. Never expose a shared gateway key in a public frontend.
V-Voice 语音转写：热词、时间戳与说话人归属: V-Voice transcription: hotwords, timestamps and speaker attribution
model 与 speaker_model 都填 v-voice/ 前缀的网关模: Use v-voice/-qualified gateway IDs for model and speaker_model; V-Router restores native IDs when forwarding. verbose_json returns text, words/segments (depending on word_timestamps capability), hotwords (including applied and active sets), and speaker attribution. No response fields are removed. Filter by capabilities instead of hardcoding model lists.
V-Voice 流式识别与声纹接入: V-Voice streaming ASR and speaker integration
流式接口仅服务声明 streaming capability 的模型，请求体边到: Streaming requires a model declaring the streaming capability. Bodies are forwarded end to end without an overall timeout; connections occupy one concurrency slot. WebSocket: GET /v1/audio/streaming/ws?model=... (binary PCM upstream, partial/final downstream). Register/delete speakers in V-Voice; V-Router exposes only listing, identify and verify. See docs/v-voice-hotwords.md for the protocol and Python WebSocket examples.
校验 VOS OIDC Bearer token 或共享网关 Key，返回 id: Validates a VOS OIDC Bearer token or shared gateway key. Returns identity, auth_method, permissions, resource_isolation=true and registration_scopes. Registered services support public/private visibility; private services are visible only to the registrant and administrators.
从运行时路由表自动生成；扩展字段和上游返回体保留，随版本即时更新。: Generated from the runtime route table. Extension fields and upstream response bodies are preserved and updated with the running version. Use lang=en for English.
按 model 查询参数路由到 TTS 上游，替换为原生模型名并透传响应；上游返: Routes by the model query parameter to the TTS upstream, restores its native model name and forwards the response. model, default_voice and equivalent voices[]/data[] lists are preserved; clients must use a returned voice ID.
Anthropic 原生上游直接转发；chat_completions 上游由: Anthropic-native upstreams are forwarded directly. For chat_completions upstreams, Go converts text, image input and function tools, including SSE. Stateless conversion does not support server-side tools, caching or thinking; model capabilities determine image/tool support. x-api-key is supported for gateway identity.
multipart/form-data：model 与 image 必填。按 m: multipart/form-data requires model and image. Adapts ml-server models for CLIP image embeddings, face recognition, person ReID or OCR. Optional: min_score, max_resolution, score_mode. Responses retain the Immich ML Server format; embedding remains a JSON-array string.
V-Router 扩展接口。JSON 中 model=ml-server/vid: V-Router extension. JSON requires model=ml-server/video-structure, asset_id and video_path; detection and per-scene tasks are optional. video_path must already exist on shared storage accessible to ML Server.
查询 ML Server 视频结构化任务: Query an ML Server video structure task
model 查询参数必填。queued/running 可重复查询；succee: The model query parameter is required. queued/running can be polled repeatedly. ML Server consumes succeeded/failed results after the first read; subsequent queries for that task_id return 404.
语音识别 ASR（支持热词文本、热词文件和增强分数）: ASR transcription (hotword text, files and boost scores)
重排序（兼容扩展，非 OpenAI 标准）: Reranking (compatible extension, not an OpenAI standard)
一只小猫在月球上奔跑: A kitten running on the moon
按 model 路由并替换原生模型名；支持: Routes by model and restores the native model name. Supports
，上游响应（含 SSE、二进制和错误）原样转发。上传上限 32 MiB；能力与参: ; upstream responses (including SSE, binary content and errors) are forwarded unchanged. Upload limit: 32 MiB. Capabilities and parameters depend on the upstream. X-VRouter-Upstream requires authentication and an upstream-native body; model may be omitted.
OpenAI 风格扩展（OpenAI 官方当前无音乐生成端点）。V-Router: OpenAI-style extension (OpenAI has no official music generation endpoint). Routes v-music/<model key> and restores the native key. Other JSON fields and WAV/FLAC binary responses are forwarded unchanged.
热词模型可透传 hotwords 文本、hotwords_file UTF-8: Hotword-capable models accept hotwords text, a UTF-8 hotwords_file, saved hotwords_set IDs (repeatable, merged and deduplicated with text/files by the server) and hotwords_score. V-Router does not parse or rewrite hotwords. timestamp_granularities[] is forwarded unchanged. V-Voice verbose_json can return OpenAI-style words/segments; discovered metadata determines support. speaker_model (a v-voice/-qualified speaker model ID, restored to its native ID) and speaker_threshold are also forwarded; when provided, verbose_json includes speaker attribution without trimming.
原生上游直接转发；Model Hub/仅 chat_completions 上游: Native upstreams are forwarded directly. For Model Hub/chat_completions-only upstreams, Go converts text, image input, function tools, structured output and SSE. store must be false or omitted. previous_response_id, background, hosted tools and server-side state are unsupported; unsupported fields return 400. Pinned upstreams still use their configured conversion and native model names.
上游返回 2xx 且含 id 时记录任务创建者；后续经 /v1/videos/: A 2xx response containing id records the task creator. Later queries/cancellation through /v1/videos/{id} enforce ownership and reject cross-account access.
1:N 说话人归属。multipart 字段：model 必填（v-voice/: 1:N speaker attribution. Multipart: model (required, v-voice/-qualified speaker model ID), file (required), threshold (optional, 0..1, default 0.6). Returns identified, speaker ({id,name,score}, null if no match), score, threshold and ranked (Top-5). Speakers are registered in V-Voice and shared at host level; V-Router does not proxy registration.
1:1 声纹验证。multipart 字段：model 必填（v-voice/: 1:1 speaker verification. Multipart: model (required, v-voice/-qualified speaker model ID), speaker (required, speaker ID or name), file (required), threshold (optional, 0..1, default 0.6). Returns verified, score, threshold and speaker. Unknown speakers return upstream 404.
仅声明 streaming capability 的模型（model 为查询参数: Requires a model declaring streaming capability. model is a query parameter: v-voice/<model key>. The body is a chunked audio byte stream (format=pcm|wav|auto; PCM defaults to 16 kHz s16le). Forwarded end to end without full buffering or an overall timeout. Query parameters hotwords, hotwords_set (repeatable), hotwords_score, response_format, speaker_model (qualified ID restored to native), speaker_threshold are forwarded. Ending the body returns the final transcription; verbose_json matches batch transcription plus streaming:true. The connection occupies one model concurrency slot.
WebSocket 升级连接（model 为查询参数，format 仅 pcm|: WebSocket upgrade with model query parameter; format is pcm|wav only. Send s16le mono PCM binary chunks; receive {type:partial,text,is_endpoint}. Sending {type:finish} as a text frame or disconnecting returns {type:final,text,tokens,timestamps}. final includes speaker attribution if speaker_model was supplied. Close codes: 4404 (unknown model), 4409 (not ready), 4422 (parameter mismatch), 4500 (inference failure). Frames and close codes are forwarded unchanged. The connection occupies one model concurrency slot.
按 model 查询参数（v-voice/<声纹模型 key>）路由到声纹模型，: Routes by model query parameter (v-voice/<speaker model key>). Returns registered speakers in equivalent speakers[]/data[] lists with id, name, dimension and created_at, plus default_threshold. No embedding vectors are returned. Registration/deletion is managed in V-Voice, outside this endpoint.
必须携带 X-VRouter-Upstream: <上游 ID> 和管理身份，使: Requires X-VRouter-Upstream: <upstream ID> and management identity. Use native parameters/model names and the same upstream for creation, queries, cancellation and downloads. Public registrations are visible to all callers; private registrations only to their registrant and administrators. A successful creation through V-Router (POST /v1/<family>, 2xx with id) records the owner; other users then get 404, except administrators. Lists still include all resources in the shared provider account. Resources predating this feature or created outside V-Router are not restricted. Query parameters, multipart, SSE, binary data and WebSocket upgrades are preserved. Unsupported operations return upstream errors.
报告 scene-detect 与 structure 是否已由 V-Route: Reports whether V-Router's periodic discovery has found scene-detect and structure. Missing or unreachable services are normal states.
保持视频结构化原始路径、请求体、状态码、响应头和响应体透传；V-Router 只: Preserves the video structure service's original path, request body, status, response headers and body. V-Router exposes business endpoints without adding the service to the base model pool.
适用于手动、Model Hub 和主动注册后端。weight 默认 1（1..1: For manual, Model Hub and registered backends. weight defaults to 1 (1..1000); max_inflight defaults to 0 (unlimited); disabled defaults to false. Limits count only this gateway's in-flight requests; SSE releases its slot on completion or cancellation. Configuration is persisted. Owner/administrators only (403); another user's private upstream returns 404.
推理后端主动注册 / 更新: Register or update an inference backend
需网关 Key 或 VOS 身份。稳定 service_id 生成 regist: Requires a gateway key or VOS identity. A stable service_id produces registered-<service_id>; the same ID updates the same instance, replicas need distinct IDs. Public services are visible to all callers; private services only to the registrant. Register a base_url/models API or explicitly supply model/models. Explicit models must declare endpoints; capabilities/model_kind supports capability filtering. model_endpoints/model_capabilities can override individual models. ttl_seconds defaults to 90.
提交 JSON {ttl_seconds:90}，建议每30秒续期。404 表示: Submit JSON {ttl_seconds:90}; renew every 30 seconds. A 404 indicates an expired lease or restarted gateway; register again. Heartbeats do not refresh models; register again when models change.
立即退出新请求分配，已开始的请求继续完成。只允许注销主动注册来源。: Immediately stops assigning new requests; existing requests finish. Only actively registered upstreams can be unregistered.
成功；上游响应体、状态码、Content-Type 保留，可能为 JSON、SS: Success. Upstream body, status and Content-Type are preserved; content may be JSON, SSE, audio or files.
网关拒绝或上游原始错误: Gateway rejection or original upstream error
指定上游 ID；严格固定，不自动切换，需身份与原生模型名。不指定时按匹配模型、协: Pins an upstream ID without fallback; requires identity and native model names. Otherwise matches model, protocol and health, selecting by in-flight requests/weight. Ties use smooth weighted rotation within the current model/interface. Returns 429 if all candidates are full. A prefix limits source; short names span sources, including cloud. Required for resource APIs.
固定为 GET /v1/models 返回的 ml-server/video-s: Must be ml-server/video-structure as returned by GET /v1/models
候选后端全部达到 max_inflight，Retry-After: 1；不排队: All candidates reached max_inflight. Retry-After: 1. No queueing or retries.
模型不存在、未发现或不支持该音频接口: Model not found, undiscovered or unsupported for this audio interface
V-Voice 模型文件尚未 ready: V-Voice model files are not ready
请求超过 V-Router 32 MiB 或 V-Voice 音频限制: Request exceeds the V-Router 32 MiB limit or V-Voice audio limit
支持热词的模型收到非法 UTF-8、超限热词、越界分数或其他字段校验失败；不支持: Invalid UTF-8, excessive hotwords, out-of-range scores or other validation errors for hotword-capable models. Models without hotword support ignore hotword fields.
网关模型全名/短名；指定上游时按上游协议: Qualified/short gateway model name; pinned requests follow the upstream protocol
逐场景 facial-recognition、clip.visual、perso: Per-scene facial-recognition, clip.visual, person-reid or ocr tasks; entries follows the corresponding /v1/ml/predictions capability structure
逗号或换行分隔的请求级热词；仅支持声明 hotwords capability: Request hotwords separated by commas or newlines; requires hotwords capability
已保存热词集 ID，可重复提交；与 hotwords、hotwords_file: Saved hotword set ID; repeatable, merged and deduplicated with hotwords/hotwords_file by the server
UTF-8 文本，每行一个热词: UTF-8 text, one hotword per line
热词增强分数；仅支持 score 的模型使用: Hotword boost score; only used by score-capable models
可重复提交 word 和/或 segment；verbose_json 返回上游: Repeat word and/or segment; verbose_json returns timestamps supported by the upstream
ml-server/ 前缀模型；可选 CLIP、buffalo_l、osnet_: ml-server/-qualified model; options include CLIP, buffalo_l, osnet_ain_x1_0 and PP-OCRv5_server
模型路由、Responses/Anthropic Messages 到 Chat: Model routing, stateless conversion from Responses/Anthropic Messages to Chat Completions, and pinned upstream resource forwarding. See endpoint descriptions for conversion limits. Native resource lifecycles are owned by the upstream.
VOS OIDC token 或网关 Key: VOS OIDC token or gateway key
Anthropic SDK 可使用网关 Key 或 VOS token；与 Be: Anthropic SDK accepts a gateway key or VOS token; if Bearer is also supplied, both credentials must match
// 用 models.data[].id 填充模型下拉框；不要在本应用保存云端: // Populate the model selector with models.data[].id; do not store cloud keys, upstream URLs or model lists in this app.
// detail.models 包含 qualified、kind、capab: // detail.models includes qualified, kind, capabilities, endpoints, upstream_kind and model_prefix for filtering chat/embedding selectors.
算力路径：云端、本机与其他节点: Compute paths: cloud, this node and other nodes
本地模型接入：由网关申请许可: Local model access: the gateway requests a permit
云端模型：应用 → V-Router → 云端供应商（无需本地许可）\n本机或已:
Cloud model: app → V-Router → cloud provider (no local permit)
Synchronous model on this or another managed node: app → V-Router → V-Scheduler permit → model service
Own asynchronous task: app → V-Scheduler task → approved node executor
按实际执行节点分类，不按 URL 猜测。云端上游不占 V-Scheduler 的: Classify by the actual execution node, not by URL. Cloud upstreams do not consume V-Scheduler node capacity. Other managed nodes reserve their own resource pool. An unmanaged remote upstream cannot claim scheduler coverage. Each computation has exactly one permit or task reservation.
调用方只使用 V-Router 模型 API，不持有 V-Scheduler 服: Callers use only V-Router model APIs and never hold the scheduler service token. Administrators approve the actual node, executor upstream_urls, and per-model input/resource limits in models[upstreamID/nativeModelID] in scheduler.local.json. Missing approval/config returns 503, capacity 429, input budget 413, parameter budget 422. HTTP/SSE, WebSocket and asynchronous creation are admitted before computation. Delegation verifies task, owner, node and budget; a declaration cannot bypass admission. WebSocket requires an approved server_close stop contract. Uncertain completion retains reservations; restart resumes asynchronous polling. Cloud providers bypass local permits.
局域网客户端：VOS 登录后直连映射端口: LAN clients: sign in to VOS, then use the mapped port
先通过 VOS API 的 POST /v1000/user/login 获取: First POST to /v1000/user/login on the VOS API and read data.access_token. Send Authorization: Bearer <access_token> to the mapped V-Router port (22888 by default; configurable through V_ROUTER_HOST_PORT). Use the device's reachable VOS API entry point, e.g. http://<vos-host>:8105 or its configured HTTPS reverse proxy. V-Router validates the token with VOS userinfo and applies usage attribution and resource permissions for that VOS user; no separate V-Router account is required. Verify identity with /api/v1/auth/me first. On 401, sign in again or refresh the token; a VOS password is not a Bearer token. Server-side calls are not subject to browser CORS; browser apps on other origins should use a same-origin proxy.
